definition: A data sampling strategy that changes which examples or data sources are prioritized over the course of training, often shifting emphasis as training progresses.
details: Curriculum sampling can be used in large-scale pretraining to emphasize higher-quality or more relevant data sources at particular stages of training, distinct from but related to curriculum learning based on example difficulty.
